Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level/reviewId are the mandatory fields on every log entry (checkpoint-logging-standard.md). Review is not one of the platform's 100%-trace-coverage services (only the Order Saga's 4 participants are) — the OpenTelemetry SDK's default sampling ratio applies.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly.

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings:ReviewDatabase/Mongo:ConnectionString/RabbitMq credentials/Identity:JwksUri values (kart-conventions.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in the gitignored appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example); a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_ReviewDatabase: Write-side PostgreSQL — source of truth for Review/ProductRating/VerifiedPurchaseRecord (database-design.md). Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or the ConnectionStrings__ReviewDatabase env var / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Read-side MongoDB — the CQRS query side GET /v1/reviews serves from (database-design.md's Read Model section). Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or env vars / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

DevSeed._comment_Enabled: Local-dev-only convenience seed (a delivered order + verified purchase to submit a review against without hand-crafting OrderCreated/OrderDelivered events first). Never true in a real environment's GlobalConfig file.
